hard_failures: Every problem requires selecting linear, quadratic, or piecewise and justifying the model from contextual evidence, but verification generally checks only a derived number or solution set.
Only problems 6 and 12 include manual entries even though the model-choice explanations recur throughout all 12 problems.

errors.description: The classification and justification responses that define the worksheet are mostly absent from verification.

artifact_findings: Independent recomputation confirms the keyed numerical outputs 115, 10, 28, roots 0 and 4, 13, 52, 8, dimensions 10 and 20, (8,84), intersections (1,4) and (5,12), 89, and the synthesis values 20 and 16.
Visual review confirms exactly 12 readable problems, though the eight-page worksheet is unusually paper-intensive.
rationale: The modeling scenarios and calculations are strong, but the declared checks do not validate the model identifications and reasons repeatedly required by the prompts. That trust-boundary failure is decisive.
